deviations.what: t10 criterion 2 'image rootfs contains no psk= strings' is read as: no tskey- anywhere (binaries included); no uncommented psk= in any non-ELF file; ELF binaries exempt for psk= (listed by the test)

deviations.what: t10 adds the provisioned arduino user to group wheel (polkit admin via run0, password-prompted), beyond criterion 4's 'non-root login user'
deviations.reason: image has no sudo; with root locked, wheel+run0 is the only admin path (e.g. run0 tailscale up, editing culture node.env); dropping it is one line

deviations.what: t19 audit-image.sh narrows d6's secrets reading: a Tailscale key is a key-shaped string (tskey-<kind>-<id>-<secret> or legacy tskey-<hex>), not any 'tskey-'; PEM private keys are flagged as full BEGIN/body/END blocks in non-ELF files
deviations.reason: on the integrated image tailscaled contains the constant 'tskey-wrap' and sshd/gnutls/NetworkManager/mime databases embed bare PEM markers; gnutls embeds FIPS self-test EC keys. The narrowed checks still catch baked key files (they found libvirt's) and any real Tailscale key, binaries included.

deviations.what: t19 removes packagegroup-qcom-virtualization (libvirt + qemu) from cultureos-image
